population_tables.interpretation: The archive README calls Mdot Msun/yr normalized by total stellar mass formed. Direct integration in physical years violates unit mass return in every metallicity column. No hidden SSP normalization factor is inferred.

huscher2025_agb.interpretation: The source is a current, openly licensed and internally parseable AGB candidate. Its single-star gross yields are useful for review, and all apparent over-ejection is contained by printed precision. The IMF-weighted Mdot table fails its stated normalization under direct physical-time integration, so neither it nor a guessed normalization may be wired into production.

release_semantics.Post: post-explosion ejecta at 30 s after bounce, decayed to stable species
release_semantics.Post_NoDecay: post-explosion ejecta at 30 s after bounce before radioactive decay
release_semantics.Presn: pre-supernova inventory above the emergent mass cut
release_semantics.Wind: integrated pre-collapse wind ejecta reported by the progenitor calculation
release_semantics.successful_explosion_mass_cut: baryonic neutron-star mass; source reports no fallback
release_semantics.failed_explosion_policy: Post and Presn are zero; pre-collapse Wind must remain independently auditable
release_semantics.canonical_channel_partition: Post and Wind are separate ownership domains and must never be summed twice through independent source channels

primary_grid.baseline_branch: VW93 MassExp without synthetic thermal-pulse extrapolation

mass_budget_review.comparison: stable ejecta plus stable wind versus labelled ZAMS mass minus P-HOTB baryonic mass cut
mass_budget_review.limitation: Tables are rounded to three significant figures and expose only 20 selected radioactive isotopes; this is not an exact complete-isotope closure identity.

machine_readable_tp_table.title: Main properties of the TP phase for all models

limongi2024_transition_fates.interpretation: At source-solar metallicity and zero rotation, Limongi et al. constrain the transition but do not define a deterministic continuous explosion law. The 8--8.8 Msun runtime edge remains a fate-policy gap, not a yield interval that may be filled by interpolation.

semantics.energy_selection: minimum thermal energy leading to full ejection above the Fe core
semantics.remnant_selection: mass cut chosen to eject 0.07 Msun of Ni56

roberti2024_ultralowz_ccsn.interpretation: The source provides directly relevant Z=0, [Fe/H]=-5, and [Fe/H]=-4 rotation-dependent yields, remnants, and kinetic energies, but only at 15 and 25 Msun. The official zero-Z MRTs omit four source columns and model 025z600 fails the otherwise tight zams-minus-remnant mass-budget pattern, so no source merge, interpolation, or canonical promotion is allowed.

physical_semantics.yield_quantity: post-supernova ejecta including wind in Msun
physical_semantics.energy_quantity: kinetic energy at infinity in Bethe (1e51 erg)

piston_locations.S4: entropy per baryon S/NA/kB=4, normally the base of the oxygen shell
piston_locations.Ye: edge of the iron core at the inward Ye drop

physical_semantics.mixing_prescription: artificial running-boxcar mixing applied before fallback

heger_woosley2010_popiii.interpretation: The official electronic table provides a dense 10--100 Msun Pop III terminal-yield grid with source-defined kinetic energies, piston locations, artificial mixing, and fallback. It materially improves zero-metallicity mass coverage, but its free explosion and mixing parameters, missing 8--10 Msun interval, omitted rotation/neutrino wind, non-age-resolved release, inferred-only remnant budget, and unresolved redistribution terms prohibit canonical or production promotion.

interpretation: Staged source files are immutable review inputs. No canonical table was generated; no physical approval was inferred from public availability.
